# Personal filesystem paths that are permitted to appear in tracked files.
#
# This file should stay EMPTY. A real CreativeBrief embeds absolute paths
# like /Users/<someone>/Photos/..., and pasting one into a doc publishes a
# stranger's (or your own) home directory and username. Use a placeholder
# instead, e.g. /path/to/your/photos/ -- see examples/love/brief.yaml for
# the pattern.
#
# If you find yourself adding an entry here, redact the document instead --
# that is almost always the correct fix.
